events.title: Platform 2026 — Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie & Seren Wagstaff
events.location: Institute of Modern Art (IMA), Fortitude Valley
events.description: The IMA's annual exhibition features ambitious new works by three Queensland emerging artists: Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie, and Seren Wagstaff. Spencer Harvie explores surreal online subcultures and AI-generated imagery, offering a rich, thought-provoking contemporary art experience.

events.title: Platform 2026 Artist Talks
events.location: IMA Ground Floor Gallery, Fortitude Valley
events.description: Join the three Queensland emerging artists – Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie, and Seren Wagstaff – as they discuss their ambitious new works featured in the IMA's annual Platform exhibition. Registration is required for this free event, offering insights into their creative processes and themes.

events.title: Jean Barth — 'Screen Tests'
events.description: Milani Gallery, a respected contemporary art space in West End, presents 'Screen Tests' by significant Australian artist Jean Barth. The exhibition runs throughout May, offering a chance to see new works in an intimate gallery setting.

events.title: HSBC German Film Festival 2026
events.location: Palace Cinemas James St & Fortitude Valley
events.description: Catch the best contemporary German cinema, direct from European festivals, at the 2026 HSBC German Film Festival. Featuring a curated selection of films from Germany, Austria, and Switzerland, it's a great opportunity to explore art-house cinema.

events.title: National Theatre Live: All My Sons
events.location: Palace Cinemas James St, Fortitude Valley
events.description: Experience a five-star, acclaimed production of Arthur Miller's 'All My Sons', starring Bryan Cranston and Marianne Jean-Baptiste, filmed live from London's West End. This disturbing and prescient play explores family dynamics and the cost of the American dream during wartime.

events.title: Alliance Française French Film Festival
events.location: Palace Cinemas James St, Fortitude Valley
events.description: The 2026 Alliance Française French Film Festival screens throughout May, showcasing the best of contemporary French cinema. While Brisbane's opening night featured 'Colours of Time' with drinks and nibbles, regular screenings are available all week.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival — Geraldine Hickey: A Weight Off My Chest
events.description: Catch beloved Australian stand-up comedian Geraldine Hickey as she performs her show 'A Weight Off My Chest' as part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival. Expect an intimate and hilarious night of unique observations.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival — Ray O'Leary: I Can See O'Leary Now The Ray Has Gone
events.description: New Zealand comedian Ray O'Leary brings his distinctive style to the Princess Theatre for 'I Can See O'Leary Now The Ray Has Gone' as part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival. Tickets are limited, so book soon for this engaging stand-up performance.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival — Pete Helliar: An International Kerfuffle
events.description: High-profile Australian comedian and TV personality Pete Helliar performs 'An International Kerfuffle' at the Princess Theatre for the Brisbane Comedy Festival. This show promises a fun and entertaining night of stand-up comedy.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival — Jason Leong (stand-up)
events.description: Malaysian comedian Jason Leong performs a stand-up set as part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival program at the Fortitude Music Hall. Known for his sharp wit and observational humor, this is a chance to see an international talent.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival — VHS
events.location: Brisbane Powerhouse, Graffiti Room, New Farm
events.description: Experience 'VHS' in the intimate Graffiti Room at Brisbane Powerhouse, an atmospheric venue within the heritage-listed building, as part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival. This show promises an engaging performance in a unique setting.

events.title: J.I.D — God Does Like World Tour
events.description: Critically acclaimed Atlanta rapper J.I.D brings his 'God Does Like World Tour' to Brisbane. Known for his intelligent and intricate lyricism, this promises to be a genuine hip-hop experience at one of Brisbane's premier live music venues.

events.title: Audrey Hobert — The Staircase To Stardom Tour
events.description: Audrey Hobert brings 'The Staircase To Stardom Tour' to Fortitude Music Hall. This is an opportunity to see the artist perform live in one of Brisbane's leading music venues.

events.title: Genesis Owusu
events.description: Catch Genesis Owusu, one of Australia's most exciting and genre-defying artists, live at Fortitude Music Hall. This high-energy performance is a must-see for fans of adventurous and original live music.

events.title: Endless Swarm — Body Hammering Australia 2026 (Brisbane)
events.description: Scotland's powerviolence act Endless Swarm brings their 'Body Hammering Australia' tour to Brisbane, promising a sweaty underground gig at BackDock Arts. This is a deeply subcultural and intense live music experience for fans of extreme genres.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival — Bron Lewis (stand-up)
events.description: Australian comedian Bron Lewis performs a sold-out stand-up show as part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival. While tickets are currently unavailable, checking for returns might offer a chance to catch this popular performer.

events.title: Weaving is Healing — Basketry Workshop
events.description: Learn the Figure 8 coil weave technique in this immersive basketry workshop, grounded in a ceremony-style sharing and healing circle. Held in the beautiful Mt Coot-tha Botanic Gardens, it's a hands-on creative and community-oriented experience.

events.title: Brisbane Social Geeks — Philosophy & Discussion Meetup
events.location: New Farm Library area & Roma Street Parklands, Brisbane
events.description: Join Brisbane Social Geeks for stimulating discussions, philosophy groups exploring topics like power, and board game meetups. This community also offers guided meditations and yoga, fostering social connections and intellectual development in a relaxed setting.

events.title: Brisbane Social and Language Exchange
events.description: A multicultural and conversational meetup in central Brisbane designed to help you meet new people, practice languages (Japanese, French, Chinese, German, Korean, Italian, Spanish, and more), and make friends. Welcomes students, expats, and locals.

events.title: Redlands Coast Adventure Fest
events.description: This free community festival, hosted by Ranger Stacey, offers over 100 activities including adrenaline experiences, hands-on workshops, and sports demonstrations. A great opportunity for outdoor and adventure-oriented social events and nature excursions near Brisbane.
